{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Fix revenue
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders
qa_mask = df['revenue'] == 999999.99
df_clean = df[~qa_mask].copy()

# Only completed orders
completed_mask = df_clean['status'] == 'completed'
df_completed = df_clean[completed_mask].copy()

# Check for confounding: channel vs customer_segment
# Cross-tabulate to see if the two groups differ in segment
ct = pd.crosstab(df_completed['channel'], df_completed['customer_segment'])
print("Cross-tabulation of channel vs customer_segment:")
print(ct)

# Compute conversion rate by channel
conv_by_channel = df_completed.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
print("\nConversion rate by channel:")
print(conv_by_channel)

# Compute average revenue by channel
avg_rev_by_channel = df_completed.groupby('channel')['revenue'].mean()
print("\nAverage revenue by channel:")
print(avg_rev_by_channel)"}
